correctness.rationale: The fan with dominating sink has reduced Laplacian determinant F_(2n), and the burning forbidden-subconfiguration test reduces to no two height-zero sites without intervening two. Adding a grain at j topples at most once per path site (first-repeat argument); precisely its maximal saturated consecutive run propagates. For an exact interval [L,R] containing j, saturated internal heights are forced and two independent boundary tails have counts w(L-1),w(n-R), giving P_j([L,R])=w(L-1)w(n-R)/F_(2n). Fibonacci tail sums factor as F_(2j-1)F_(2(n-j)+1), proving zero probability and exact conditional arm independence. Summing over j gives the complete multivariate interval support polynomial. Binet gives bulk mass t phi^(-2t)/sqrt(5); sandpile group translation plus one grain lost per toppling gives exact E_j[T]=1. Rebuilt burning, recurrence and toppling simulation for all stable states n=2..8 and j, checking every interval count; finite checks are not the infinite proof.
